title: Digital Project Coordinator IT
location: AB Square, Navi Mumbai, Maharashtra, India
jobDescription:
JOB PURPOSE

To act as the single-point coordinator for R&D digital and IT systems, ensuring seamless user experience and issue resolution by interfacing with R&D stakeholders and orchestrating backend IT infrastructure, PLM (Windchill), and vendor support teams.

This role focuses on ownership, coordination, and delivery of outcomes, ensuring systems run effectively and R&D users are supported with minimal disruption.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

🔷 1. End-to-End Issue Ownership

  • Act as SPOC for all IT and R&D digital system issues

  • Own lifecycle from:

  • Issue logging → tracking → resolution → closure

  • Ensure no gaps between teams and complete closure within SLA


🔷 2. Business–IT Interface (R&D Focus)

  • Work closely with R&D functions (PD, TD, QA, SCM, etc.)

  • Understand user challenges and translate into:

  • IT / PLM actionable requirements

  • Ensure clear communication and expectation management


🔷 3. R&D Digital Systems Coordination

  • Coordinate operations and support for:

  • Windchill PLM

  • Artwork Management systems

  • MS Projects / NPD tools

  • Track:

  • Issues, enhancements, and change requests


🔷 4. Backend Team & Vendor Coordination

  • Interface with:

  • IT infrastructure teams (network, access, hardware)

  • PLM support teams

  • External vendors

  • Drive issue resolution through follow-ups and escalations


🔷 5. Tracking, MIS & Governance

  • Maintain:

  • Issue logs, trackers, and SLA dashboards

  • Generate:

  • Basic MIS on system performance, issues, and usage

  • Ensure:

  • Documentation completeness and audit readiness


🔷 6. User Experience & Continuous Improvement

  • Identify recurring issues and improvement opportunities

  • Collaborate with IT/PLM teams to enhance:

  • System usability

  • Adoption and efficiency


🔷 7. Project & Change Support

  • Support execution of:

  • System upgrades

  • Enhancements and change rollouts

  • Coordinate UAT and user readiness activities


EDUCATIONAL QUALIFICATIONS

  • B.E / B.Tech / BSc (IT, Computer Science, Engineering or related field)


WORK EXPERIENCE

  • 1–4 years of experience in:

  • IT support / system coordination / PMO / PLM support roles


PREFERRED / ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS

  • Basic understanding of:

  • IT infrastructure and networking concepts

  • PLM systems (Windchill preferred)

  • Ticketing tools (Service Now or equivalent)

  • Strong:

  • Communication and stakeholder management skills

  • Ownership mindset and problem-solving ability

  • Exposure to:

  • R&D / engineering systems (preferred but not mandatory)


INTERNAL / EXTERNAL INTERFACE

  • R&D Teams (PD, TD, QA, SCM)

  • IT Infrastructure & Application Teams

  • PLM Support Teams

  • External Vendors / Implementation Partners


BEHAVIORAL COMPETENCIES

  • Think Beyond – Drives proactive problem resolution

  • Collaborate to Win – Coordinates effectively across teams

  • Be Agile – Responds quickly to dynamic issues

  • Put Customers First – Focus on R&D user experience
